title.narrative: IDLO Advancing integrity and transparency for a modern justice sector 2024-2027
IDLO Främja integritet och öppenhet för en modern rättssektor 2024-2027

description.narrative: Initiativet är utformat för att bekämpa korruption och stärka medborgarnas engagemang i rättsväsendet genom att utnyttja digital teknik för att öka transparens, integritet, effektivitet och ansvarsutkrävande. Projektet syftar också till att bygga vidare på Moldaviens befintliga digitala infrastruktur genom att implementera omfattande digitala ärendehanteringssystem för att effektivisera processer, minska förseningar och förbättra spårning och hantering av ärenden. Lösningar för e-förvaltning kommer att förbättra kommunikationen och samordningen mellan institutioner inom rättssektorn, samtidigt som medborgarna får enklare tillgång till juridisk information och tjänster. Dessutom kommer utvecklingen av digitala plattformar för rapportering och övervakning av korruption att ge allmänheten möjlighet att spela en aktiv roll för att säkerställa ansvarsskyldighet och främja en integritetskultur. Genom att göra detta syftar initiativet till att påskynda Moldaviens framsteg mot EU-integration och stärkandet av landets demokratiska institutioner.

This initiative is designed to combat entrenched corruption and strengthen civic engagement with justice sector institutions by leveraging digital technologies to enhance transparency, integrity, efficiency, and accountability. This project also seeks to build on Moldova’s existing digital infrastructure by implementing comprehensive digital case management systems to streamline processes, reduce delays, and improve case tracking and management. E-governance solutions will enhance communication and coordination among justice sector institutions, while also providing citizens with easier access to legal information and services. Moreover, the development of digital platforms for reporting and monitoring corruption will empower the public to play an active role in ensuring accountability, fostering a culture of integrity. By doing so, the initiative aims to accelerate Moldova’s progress towards EU integration and the strengthening of its democratic institutions.

The International Development Law Organization (IDLO) seeks the financial support of the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida) for a pivotal initiative in Moldova. This initiative is designed to combat entrenched corruption and strengthen civic engagement with justice sector institutions by leveraging digital technologies to enhance transparency, integrity, efficiency, and accountability.
Moldova, a candidate country for European Union (EU) membership since 2022, has made significant strides in reforming its justice sector, particularly since the signing of the Association Agreement with the EU in 2014. However, ongoing high-level corruption and the slow pace of justice system reforms continue to pose significant challenges to Moldova's EU accession and broader national development goals. Despite the progress acknowledged by the European Commission, key areas of reform, particularly those related to the rule of law, de-oligarchizing, and the integrity and accountability of justice institutions, remain incomplete. This initiative, supported by Sida, is designed to address these gaps and support Moldova's continued progress towards EU integration and the strengthening of its democratic institutions.
This project also seeks to build on Moldovas existing digital infrastructure by implementing comprehensive digital case management systems to streamline processes, reduce delays, and improve case tracking and management. E-governance solutions will enhance communication and coordination among justice sector institutions, while also providing citizens with easier access to legal information and services. Moreover, the development of digital platforms for reporting and monitoring corruption will empower the public to play an active role in ensuring accountability, fostering a culture of integrity. By doing so, the initiative aims to accelerate Moldovas progress towards EU integration and the strengthening of its democratic institutions.
